> Eod · 2026-07-02

Source: `C:\TAG Marketing Claude\_Shared (All Clients)\EOD Reports\EOD Report 2026-07-02.txt`

Thursday. Two single-client sessions.

# Alphalete Trenchless
File: `EOD Report 2026-07-02 Alphalete.txt`. See [Alphalete Trenchless (Hub)](lib:brain-alphalete-trenchless-hub).
- Diagnosed "Not available" Yoast SEO and Readability scores on all 20 blog posts: Elementor-built posts never saved through the block editor, so Yoast never cached scores.
- Fix: open and save each post in the block editor. Proved on 2 posts, then applied to the remaining 7.
- Result: 0 "Not available"; 17 posts green on both scores; 3 orange for real content issues (passive voice over 10% and repeated sentence openers): How Long Does Trenchless Sewer Repair Take?, Tree Roots in Sewer Line?, Sewer Line Repair Without Digging.

# Pipeliners
File: `EOD Report 2026-07-02.txt`. See [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub).
- Sidebar Social Links widget cleanup: removed theme-vendor (pixfort) X/Twitter and Dribbble placeholders, pointed Facebook and Instagram to the real Pipeliners accounts, added LinkedIn. Now 3 verified icons, live.

# Follow-ups
- Alphalete: fix passive voice and sentence openers on the 3 orange posts via Elementor (no deadline).
- Pipeliners: none; footer and other widget social links could be a separate pass.
